admin_exchanges_description: Draw names so everyone gifts to one person.
admin_exchanges_gift_date_past: The gift date can't be in the past.
admin_exchanges_too_few: Add at least {minimum} people to draw names.
admin_exchanges_repeat_expected_title: Not everyone can get someone new
admin_exchanges_repeat_expected_body: Some people will have the same person they had in {name}.
admin_exchanges_delete_body: Names haven't been drawn yet, so the exchange and its people are deleted. This can't be undone.
admin_exchanges_archive_body: The exchange ends for everyone, and this page then lists who gifted to whom. This can't be undone.
admin_exchanges_redraw_body: Everyone gets a new person to gift to.
admin_exchanges_redraw_body_looked: Someone has already looked at who they have. Everyone gets a new person to gift to and is told their assignment changed.
admin_exchanges_people_description: Pick someone to change who they can gift to and who can gift to them.
admin_exchanges_people_empty: Nobody yet. Add people to get started.
admin_exchanges_person_counts: Can gift to {gives}. {receives} can gift to {name}.
admin_exchanges_matrix_description: Pick a name to change it.
admin_exchanges_tip_off: Can {giver} gift to {recipient}? An admin answered No.
admin_exchanges_legend_locked_hint: Can't see their lists, or would gift to their own guardian
admin_exchanges_locked_guardian: {giver} can't gift to {recipient}, who is {giver}'s guardian
admin_exchanges_locked_denied: {giver} can't gift to {recipient} because {giver} can't see {recipient}'s lists
admin_exchanges_problem_nobody_to_gift_t: Answer Yes for at least one person they can gift to.
admin_exchanges_problem_nobody_can_gift_: Answer Yes for at least one person who can gift to them.

match.recipientPlural=one: That's {giverCount} people gifting and only {recipientCount} person to gift to.
match.recipientPlural=*: That's {giverCount} people gifting and only {recipientCount} people to gift to.

admin_exchanges_problem_stuck_givers_fix: Let one of them gift to someone else.

match.giverPlural=one: That's {recipientCount} people to gift to and only {giverCount} person gifting.
match.giverPlural=*: That's {recipientCount} people to gift to and only {giverCount} people gifting.

admin_exchanges_problem_stuck_recipients: Let someone else gift to one of them.
admin_exchanges_rules_drawn_note: Names are already drawn. Saving a change here redraws them for everyone.
admin_exchanges_rules_empty: Add more people to choose who they can gift to.
admin_exchanges_remove_body_drawn: Names are already drawn. Whoever had {name} gets a new person and is told their assignment changed.
admin_exchanges_remove_redraw_body: Whoever had {name} can't take on the person {name} had, so names have to be redrawn for everyone.
admin_exchanges_pairings_description: Shown because this exchange is archived.
admin_exchanges_error_archived: This exchange is archived and can't be changed.
admin_exchanges_error_gift_date_in_past: The gift date can't be in the past.
admin_exchanges_error_user_not_found: One of those people no longer exists.
admin_exchanges_error_already_drawn: Names are already drawn, so this exchange can't be deleted. Archive it instead.
admin_exchanges_error_invalid_block: That change couldn't be saved. Reload the page and try again.
admin_exchanges_error_needs_redraw: {name} can't be fitted in without redrawing names. Redraw first, then add them.
admin_exchanges_error_needs_redraw_gener: Someone can't be fitted in without redrawing names. Redraw first, then add them.

match.p=one: {count} person who hasn't been emailed yet gets an email saying their assignment is ready. It doesn't say who they have.
match.p=*: {count} people who haven't been emailed yet get an email saying their assignment is ready. It doesn't say who anyone has.

admin_exchanges_emails_none_sent: No emails could be sent. Try again in a moment.

match.p=one: {failed} email couldn't be sent. Press Send Emails to try again.
match.p=*: {failed} emails couldn't be sent. Press Send Emails to try again.

admin_exchanges_emails_switched_off: Gift exchange emails are off in Email settings.
